status.title: Status
status.name: Name
status.client_auth_description: MCP clients must send HTTP Basic Auth on /mcp: a Nextcloud user name and an app password (Settings, Security, Devices and sessions). Without that header the server has no Nextcloud account to use. This module does not store those credentials. A browser will not send them. The Cursor example is on the About page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: This hostname is already used by another route
settings.invalid_url: Enter an http or https URL without embedded credentials
settings.invalid_model: Enter an embedding model name without spaces
settings.nextcloud_host_help: Base URL of Nextcloud. The NS8 node must be able to reach it. No trailing slash needed.
settings.client_auth_help: This module does not store a Nextcloud user name or app password. Each MCP client sends HTTP Basic Auth (user name and app password) to /mcp. Create the app password in Nextcloud under Settings, Security, Devices and sessions. Do not use the account login password.
settings.ollama_base_url_help: Ollama runs on another host. This module does not start Ollama or a GPU.
settings.ollama_embedding_model_help: Must already be pulled on the Ollama host, for example nomic-embed-text.
settings.enable_semantic_search_help: Uses the Qdrant sidecar in this module. The Ollama URL and embedding model are required only while this is enabled.

about.title: About
about.client_auth_lead: Point Cursor at https://YOUR_FQDN/mcp. Each request needs HTTP Basic Auth: the Nextcloud user name and an app password, as base64 of user:app_password. Do not commit that secret.
about.client_auth_env: Cursor substitutes ${env:NAME} in mcp.json url and headers. Export NEXTCLOUD_MCP_BASIC_AUTH as the base64 token in the environment the Cursor process can see. A value set only in a shell profile is invisible when Cursor is launched from the desktop menu. Preferred config:
about.client_auth_literal: A literal header also works: Authorization: Basic BASE64_OF_user:app_password. Prefer the environment variable so the app password is not written into mcp.json.
